customManagers.description: Sole K3s image manager: repository/tag pairs and single-line image refs. currentDigest is captured so digest-pinned images are recognized as pinned and refreshed; without it Renovate re-pins them and the branch update fails verification. The built-in kubernetes manager is intentionally not scoped to these files: it also extracts Deployment/NetworkPolicy API versions and duplicate image deps.

immich-machine-learning: GHCR publishes 200k+ tags (per-commit/PR/variant builds), so the docker datasource's fetch-all-pages enumeration intermittently fails and Renovate skips the update with no-result. Look the version up from the immich GitHub releases instead (tiny list, authenticated by the platform token). currentValue captures only the base version, so the default replacement preserves the backend suffix: v3.1.0-openvino -> v3.2.0-openvino, and likewise for -rocm/cuda/armnn/rknn.
Frigate images, including the -rocm variant. currentValue captures the base version so the default replacement preserves the suffix.
helm.cattle.io HelmChart CR chart versions (oci:// — via docker datasource; the helm datasource has no OCI support)
helm.cattle.io HelmChart CR chart versions (classic chart:+repo: form)
Traefik plugin version pins in additionalArguments (k3s HelmChartConfig + compose)
Home Assistant Frigate integration pinned version (no runtime GitHub API polling)
Advanced Camera Card pinned version (no runtime GitHub API polling)
dotdc Grafana dashboard URLs in the k8s-monitoring values (all six dashboards share one version)
Ludusavi release fetched by the bigpc Compose agent's artifact init

packageRules.description: vite and @vitejs/plugin-react are peer-coupled: plugin-react 6 needs vite 7/8 and vite 8 needs plugin-react 6, so a major of either alone cannot resolve a lockfile (renovate/artifacts fails). Group them so one branch carries both.

Channel-only images that are rebuilt faster than the 3-day age gate: first-party app :latest images, LinuxServer :latest, ComfyUI xpu-master, llama.cpp channel tags, and the Bitnami DB/kubectl images (no usable version tags; kubectl is kept because the Helm hooks need bash/jq). These are digest-pinned and reviewed at the manual rollout gate. Every other image uses an immutable version tag and waits the full minimumReleaseAge.

GHCR, Quay, GitLab and registry.k8s.io expose no per-tag timestamps, so minimumReleaseAgeBehaviour=timestamp-required would hold their updates in the Dependency Dashboard's Pending Status Checks forever. Docker Hub is the only registry Renovate can timestamp (it needs the pagination cap set in RENOVATE_DOCKER_MAX_PAGES, see scripts/renovate.sh and the CronJob). Allow timestamp-less registry tags through while keeping the 3-day gate wherever a timestamp exists.
One PR for all docker digest pins and refreshes (the noisy batch); version bumps stay separate
nfs-server source deps: isolated PR; after merge the image workflow rebuilds and a later Infra Renovate pass opens the digest PR
No major bumps for postgres, clickhouse/clickhouse-server, fedora, helm (their majors need manual migrations)
Authelia charts use the ghcr.io registry; track the actual image, not the registry-less Docker Hub name
Headlamp charts use the ghcr.io registry; track the actual image
Seerr charts use the ghcr.io registry; track the actual image
immich postgres: same-shape tags only (major-vectorchordX.Y.Z-pgvectorA.B.C), locked to the current postgres major via the compatibility group so pg-major jumps stay manual

immich-server: GHCR publishes ~30k tags, so the docker datasource's fetch-all-pages enumeration intermittently fails and Renovate skips the update with no-result. Look the version up from the immich GitHub releases instead (authenticated by the platform token).

immich-machine-learning is handled by the dedicated github-releases custom manager; disable the generic docker dep so it neither re-hits the 200k-tag GHCR lookup nor drops the backend suffix. Excluding it in the generic regex is impossible because Renovate's regex engine (RE2) has no lookahead.
Frigate images are handled by the dedicated variant-aware manager; disable the generic docker dep so it does not propose an un-suffixed tag for the -rocm image.
nfs-server image source: a Dockerfile base bump is inert until the image is rebuilt and the digest re-pinned
prBodyNotes: After merging, the NFS server image workflow rebuilds and pushes a new digest; the next Infra Renovate run pins it in the docker-digests PR. Deploy `srv0-base` after that PR merges. The Dockerfile bump alone does not change the running image.

packageRules.description: Final image digest pins are the manual rollout gate; label them for the renovate-pr-ops skill
